title: Slovakian Zucchini Casserole
description: A traditional Slovakian dish made with zucchini, creamy sauce, and a crunchy topping. Perfect for a comforting meal.
instructions: In a large skillet, cook the ground beef over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the sliced zucchini to the skillet and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
In a separate bowl, mix together the sour cream, paprika, salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
Combine the cooked zucchini mixture and sour cream mixture in the skillet.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Sprinkle the bread crumbs and shredded cheese evenly over the top of the casserole.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is hot and bubbly.
